messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up — MerchantWave dedicated rollout scheduled for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. Requesting final go/no-go and a quick KMS collision check. Plan summary: pin model `redwood-quant-v2.3`, canary 5% for 30m, then 50% for 30m, then 100%. Rollback target: v2026-03-20-prod. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/merchantwave/2026-03-21

Marcos Alvarez: Ack. Quick Q — our org KMS rotation is slated 03:00 UTC that night. If that's still on, it will collide with the customer key. I'll coordinate with infra to postpone.

Liam O'Connor: Can we tighten the rollback gating? I propose: any sustained p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m OR absolute error rate increase >= 1.0% (user-facing 5xxs) triggers auto-rollback. Also log-level sampling enabled for traces.

Sofia Chen: Added CS/SE runbook notes and the merchant contact. Confirming data-plane region is eu-west-1 per their VPC request. Also calling out quantization profile applied (8-bit dynamic).

deploybot: Deploybot: queued release merchantwave-dedicated:v2026-03-21-rc1. Will execute canary slice 5% at 02:00 UTC.

ci/cd-bot: Checklist: certs ✅, healthchecks configured ✅, feature-flag `merchantwave_dedicated` set to on for canary. KMS key arn (redacted): arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:XXXX:key/abcd-ef01. Please confirm key not rotating.

CloudOncallBot: Alert: detected scheduled KMS rotation for key abcd-ef01 at 03:00 UTC. Ops note: postponing rotation to 06:00 UTC to avoid collision.

Marcos Alvarez: I approve the rollout provided the rollback play is rehearsed. My thumbs-up pending confirmation we can snapshot and restore slice config quickly. Rollback play: revert traffic -> v2026-03-20-prod, clear kv-cache, and re-pin routing.

Priya Nair: Copy. Rollback command in ops handbook:
```
# rollback example
./infra roll-slice --tenant merchantwave --target v2026-03-20-prod --clear-cache --drain-5m
```
We'll test the command in staging before 01:00 UTC.

Rachel (PM): MerchantWave legal accepted the 2-hour maintenance window. They asked for a short bullet release note they can send to their users. Draft: "Improved inference latency and stability; pinning model version for consistent quality. Small maintenance window required."

Sofia Chen: Perf baseline for their workload: p95 ~180ms. With quantization and dedicated GPUs expect p95 ~220ms. We'll keep an eye on token-level cost changes as well. Alerts configured for token cost > +30% to notify finance.

Marcos Alvarez: +1 on rollback thresholds and finance alert. I've updated the scheduling page and pinned a link to the runbook. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Final check: Approvers = Marcos, Liam, Sofia, Rachel. Any objections?

Liam O'Connor: No objections from me. Approve.

Sofia Chen: Approve.

Marcos Alvarez: Approve.

deploybot: Deploybot: canary rollout started at 02:00 UTC -> merchantwave-dedicated:v2026-03-21-rc1 (5%). Healthchecks passing.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — monitoring dashboard up at https://console.redwood/rollouts/merchantwave. If anything spikes, we execute rollback immediately.

deploybot: Deploybot: canary at 5% healthy for 30m. Proceeding to 50% ramp at 02:35 UTC.

CloudOncallBot: Note: KMS rotation postponed to 06:00 UTC.

Priya Nair: All approvers confirmed in thread. Marking go for scheduled window. Will ping again on completion and post final release note.

deploybot: Deploybot: canary completed and ramped to 100% at 03:10 UTC. No rollback required. Release finalized.

Marcos Alvarez: Nice. Follow-up: let's run a post-mortem in 48h to validate cost delta and any subtle error regressions.

Rachel (PM): MerchantWave PM acknowledged. They'll share initial feedback by EOD. Thanks team!
